name: [Portal] Public read API — full partners_web contract (BE)
description:
### Summary

CZ3TDR1-678 scopes a public read API for the professionals/medailonek list+detail only. `partners_web`'s actual `contract/openapi.yaml` needs seven resource groups (`site`, `categories` ×3 taxonomies, `professionals` + `/professionals/regions`, `requests`, `webinars`, `sitemap`, `forms`). This task is the integration point turning every domain-layer task above into the concrete HTTP surface `partners_web`'s `HttpApi` (`DATA_SOURCE=http`) calls at build time.

### Why?

`partners_web/AGENTS.md` states a real API backend is "out of scope for now" on that side — `HttpApi` is a typed skeleton against the committed `contract/openapi.yaml`. Nothing implements the other side of that contract yet; CZ3TDR1-678 alone only covers professionals.

### What?

Implement every path in `contract/openapi.yaml` against the domain layers built by CZ3TDR1-674/678 and CZ3TDR1-717/718/719/720/721: `GET /site` (CZ3TDR1-716), `GET /categories/{taxonomy}` for all three taxonomies (CZ3TDR1-674 + CZ3TDR1-717 for professionals, CZ3TDR1-720 for webinars, CZ3TDR1-719 for requests), `GET /professionals` + `/professionals/regions` + `/professionals/{slug}` (CZ3TDR1-674, CZ3TDR1-713 for regions), `GET /requests*` (CZ3TDR1-719), `GET /webinars*` (CZ3TDR1-720), `GET /sitemap` (published slugs across all three collections), and every `forms` POST (CZ3TDR1-718, CZ3TDR1-719, CZ3TDR1-721). Response shapes must match `contract/openapi.yaml` byte-for-byte since `partners_web/src/lib/api/types.ts` is generated from the same contract.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every path/schema in `contract/openapi.yaml` implemented; a contract test validates real responses against the committed OpenAPI file
- [ ] `?locale=cz|sk|hu` scoping honored on every list endpoint per the contract's convention section, even though only `cz` has real data yet
- [ ] Pagination envelope (`items`/`meta{page,perPage,totalItems,totalPages}`) identical across all four list endpoints; out-of-range page returns empty `items` with real `meta`, not a 404
- [ ] Ordering rules match `PartnersApi.ts`'s documented semantics exactly (professionals: verified level → review count → rating → title; requests/webinars: date)
- [ ] `Authorization: Bearer <token>` required on GET endpoints per the contract's `bearerAuth` security scheme; `security: []` (public) on every `forms` POST
- [ ] Author e-mail addresses never appear in any response — automated test asserting the field is absent from serialized output, not just unset in the DTO
- [ ] OpenAPI description committed next to the implementation, or this repo's copy kept in sync with `partners_web/contract/openapi.yaml` — decide which is source of truth and note it in both READMEs
- [ ] Integration tests per resource group; PHPStan level 10

### Open questions

- Where does this live — `cms/packages/PartnerPortal` (DevRel) vs. `api/`/`marketplace/` (api-team)? CZ3TDR1-678 flagged the same question; resolve once for both.

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-674, CZ3TDR1-678, CZ3TDR1-712, CZ3TDR1-713, CZ3TDR1-716, CZ3TDR1-717, CZ3TDR1-718, CZ3TDR1-719, CZ3TDR1-720, CZ3TDR1-721
- Feeds: the CORS/token task filed alongside this one, and CZ3TDR1-682 (websites consuming the API)
- Contract: `partners_web/contract/openapi.yaml` in the `shoptet/microsites` monorepo

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Sonnet 5, 2026-09-22._ `partners_web/AGENTS.md` states the OpenAPI contract and `src/lib/api/types.ts` change together in one commit on that side — treat this contract as the frozen interface this task must satisfy, not a starting point to renegotiate unilaterally.
